key.name: app-launch-counts
key.summary: Count of app launches indexed by app id
key.description: A table of apps that have been launced and the total count. Used for sorting apps.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of dialog window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of dialog window in pixels.

key.name: post-launch-sleep
key.summary: Wait time for app launch to occur
key.description: Microseconds to wait for launching app before exit.

key.name: fuzzy-matching
key.description: If true, a row whose text does not hold every typed word is also listed when the characters of each word appear in its main text in order, with other characters between them. Such rows come after the other matches.

key.name: match-fields
key.summary: Application fields the filter searches besides the name
key.description: The fields of an application, besides its name, that typed words are looked for in: any of "generic-name", "keywords" and "comment". Other entries are ignored; an empty list searches the name only.

key.name: hidden-apps
key.summary: Applications left out of the list
key.description: Desktop file ids of applications never listed on the applications page, for example "org.gnome.Seahorse.Application.desktop". An entry may be a pattern, in which * stands for any run of characters and ? for exactly one character. An entry starting with ! lists again what the rest of it matches; when several entries match an id, the last one decides. Changes apply while the launcher runs. Ctrl+Delete on the applications page adds the highlighted application's id at the end, and Ctrl+z takes the latest id it added out again.
